summary: The first hard-push slice seeded ten TOD growth objectives, verified live Studio coverage, corrected a blocker-classification mistake, and produced first policy outputs for TOD execution growth.

live_verification.corrected_issue: Initial objective seeds used blocker text for work still to do, causing TOD to select blocker_repair for every new training objective. The seeds were corrected so work belongs in current_driving_task and blockers remain none unless truly blocked.

objective_outputs.first_output: Live Projects API exposes a TOD next-action candidate for every non-deleted project.
objective_outputs.next_action: Expand training set from StudioProjectEvent and TOD result artifacts.

objective_outputs.first_output: Successor envelope categories defined: closeout, successor task, blocker repair, escalation packet, archive decision.
objective_outputs.next_action: Bind successor envelope creation to fresh TOD result artifacts.

objective_outputs.first_output: Repair ladder defined: TOD self-repair, MIM coordination, Codex escalation, external dependency, Dave final authority.
objective_outputs.next_action: Map current blocker classes to repair ladder levels.

objective_outputs.first_output: Evidence classes identified: file changes, tests, live API/UI verification, generated artifact, hardware/operator evidence.
Scope split rule active on Projects: scope-expanded work must become follow-on work before original completion can drift.
objective_outputs.next_action: Apply split pass to Scope Expanded and Scope Watch projects.

objective_outputs.first_output: First continuity target selected: AgentMIM Forum Graphics Quality.
objective_outputs.next_action: Generate continuity brief before any implementation change.

objective_outputs.first_output: Probe classes identified by project type: UI render/API smoke, backend contract test, data source audit, training artifact validation, hardware operator evidence.
objective_outputs.next_action: Map current project types to minimal probes.

objective_outputs.first_output: Recovery outcomes defined: promote, block, archive, bounded task, Dave decision, external dependency, Codex escalation.
objective_outputs.next_action: Run recovery sweep over waiting, needs-acceptance, and scope-expanded projects.

objective_outputs.first_output: Codex packet fields defined: objective, context, acceptance, files, attempts, blockers, evidence, requested action, validation plan.
objective_outputs.next_action: Backfill Studio Projects Table Organization as the first rescue packet example.

objective_outputs.first_output: Learning record shape defined: situation, selected action, outcome, repair, updated policy, reusable lesson.
objective_outputs.next_action: Backfill learning records from completed, blocked, rescued, and auto-intervened states.

lessons: A task requirement should not be stored as a blocker unless it truly prevents movement.
TOD needs task selection and state classification together; wrong classification creates wrong next actions.
Fast hard pushes should include live verification after every seed/change.
The sprint should use Codex direction to create scaffolding, then TOD uses the scaffold to produce artifacts and evidence.
